TypeVoice 1.0.11 — 22 September 2026

  • Lists, said the way people say them. "I want three things today. So first lights, second camera and third glasses" becomes a numbered list; "add these to my list. Eggs, basket, sugar, and that's all" becomes bullets, with the "and that's all" dropped. The ordinals no longer have to start a sentence, a count ("three things", "a couple of points") announces the list, and whatever you say after the list stays as a sentence below it.
  • Saying "bullet point" as a word ("it should be in a bullet point") no longer turns into one.
